name: Ahri Remono
source: The Emperor's youngest daughter. Proud and stubborn, Ahri often challenges those around her to contests of intelligence and will. As the Emperor's daughter, few accept these challenges, leading her to have an inflated ego. Brilliant and determined, Ahri won't settle for anything less than being the best there is.
